text: A hands-on benchmark page often carries no publication date of its own: the only dated record may be the Hacker News submission (Algolia search_by_date gives created_at for the story). Date the row by that submission and write 'circulated on <date>' in the article rather than 'published on <date>' — the reviewer will otherwise assert a publication date the source never states, which is the class of defect review_audit's numeric comparison cannot see.

When the art director's alt text arrives as the overlay copy (headline glued to the front, title-cased, stray apostrophe capitals such as "Box'S"), the sidecar context/assets/illustrations/<slug>/featured.json usually already holds a clean alt from revision 1 in its history[] block — restore that instead of authoring a new one, then still check it against the pixels (the image is what the reader sees, not the brief).
